name: CRT_Entry
evidence: CRT startup; calls the WinMain-style function with HINSTANCE/cmdline.

name: WinMain
evidence: Registers class 'Pizza Connection 2', parses command line, plays intros, creates Game and runs GameMain.

name: GameMain
evidence: Called by WinMain; resets state, calls GameLoop_DispatchScreens, then shuts screens down.

name: GameLoop_DispatchScreens
evidence: Opens mission.txt, loads mission list, waits on exit event and dispatches screen states 0x15-0x1d.

name: ResetScreenRegistry
evidence: Clears five 100-entry global screen/UI registries.

name: SetScreenRects
evidence: SetRect for 800x600 game viewport and 860x600 side panel.

name: ShutdownScreens
evidence: Destroys active screen/window objects once during shutdown.

name: ResourceManager_Init
evidence: Creates 0x1ac4-byte resource manager and registers sprites/fonts/pictures/daten aliases.

name: ResourceManager_Construct
evidence: Resource manager constructor; assigns vtable 0x55c2f0 and creates internal named lock.

name: Resource_Open
evidence: Central resource opener (18 callers); resolves archive/filesystem paths.

name: Resource_Read
evidence: Reads bytes from opened resource/file object.

name: Resource_ReadLine
evidence: Reads a CR/LF-terminated line from an opened resource.

name: Resource_Close
evidence: Closes opened resource/file object.

name: Resource_GetSize
evidence: Returns declared size of opened resource.

name: FileObject_Open
evidence: Opens resource as file object; assigns vtable 0x55c2f4.

name: Language_LoadLDF
evidence: Opens language.ldf through Resource_Open, reads it and builds the string table.

name: Language_MapStrings
evidence: Bulk-copies parsed LDF string pointers into the globals used by UI strings.

name: Game_Construct
evidence: WinMain allocates 0x2f890 bytes and calls this; assigns Game vtable 0x55c5d0 and loads animations/sprites.

name: Map_LoadIsodata
evidence: Opens Isodaten.idx, reads tile records and builds isometric map objects.

name: Movie_Play
evidence: Creates a movie window, uses BinkOpen and plays intro_*.bik clips.

name: DirectDraw_Init
evidence: Calls DirectDrawCreate and configures the display.

name: Window_Construct
evidence: Constructs window/surface object; assigns vtable 0x55c814.

name: MovieWindow_Construct
evidence: Bink movie window constructor; assigns vtable 0x55c7b0 and calls BinkOpen.

name: Dialog_Construct
evidence: Rectangular dialog constructor; SetRect + vtable 0x55c808.

name: FullscreenImage_Load
evidence: Loads TGA/fullscreen image resource into a window object.

name: Sprite_Load
evidence: Parses .spr sprite resource; assigns vtable 0x55c82c.

name: UI_Init
evidence: Creates the 0x83e8-byte UI manager, registers Game_WindowProc, sets default colors/font.

name: Game_WindowProc
evidence: Window/message procedure registered by UI_Init; dispatches WM_* and custom commands, sound toggle, and screenshot branch pizza_shot%d.tga.

name: UI_CreateWindow
evidence: Creates/registers UI window from sprite resource; 113 call sites.

name: UI_FindWindowByID
evidence: Finds UI window object by numeric ID in UI manager table.

name: UI_AddText
evidence: Creates UI text element bound to a font resource; 112 call sites.

name: UI_AddImage
evidence: Creates UI image element from sprite resource; 110 call sites.

name: UI_AddSprite
evidence: Loads sprite resource and attaches it as UI element.

name: SoundSystem_Init
evidence: Initializes DirectSound, opens resources/sound.pak, logs success/failure.

name: Sound_CreatePrimaryBuffer
evidence: Creates DirectSound primary buffer; logs 'creating primary buffer'.

name: Input_MouseHandler
evidence: Handles mouse movement/buttons and updates cursor/input state.

name: RegistryKey_OpenOrCreate
evidence: Opens or creates game settings registry key.

name: RegistryKey_ReadValue
evidence: Reads registry value into newly allocated buffer.

name: RegistryKey_WriteValue
evidence: Writes registry value for game settings.

name: Mem_Free
evidence: HeapFree/CRT free wrapper; 732 call sites.

name: String_Format
evidence: sprintf-like formatting into caller buffer; 172 call sites.

name: CS_Enter
evidence: EnterCriticalSection wrapper; records owning thread.

name: CS_Leave
evidence: LeaveCriticalSection wrapper.

name: List_Node_Destroy
evidence: Destructor for two-pointer list node.

name: List_Add
evidence: Growable pointer-list append under global lock; 111 call sites.

name: IDMap_Lookup
evidence: ID map lookup: direct index below 100000, binary search above.

name: Random_Range
evidence: Pseudo-random integer in inclusive range; 103 call sites.

name: Screen_MainMenu
evidence: Builds main menu from Pe_Startscreen.tga.

name: Screen_MissionBriefing
evidence: Builds mission briefing from PE_MISSIONSBRIEFING_*.tga.

name: Screen_FreePlaySetup
evidence: Builds free-play/new-game setup from Pe_Freies_Spiel.tga.

name: Screen_CharacterSelect
evidence: Builds character selection from Pe_Charakterauswahl.tga.

name: Screen_SubStartMenu_A
evidence: PE_SUB_STARTSCREEN submenu dispatched in state 0x19.

name: Screen_SubStartMenu_B
evidence: PE_SUB_STARTSCREEN submenu dispatched in state 0x1b.

name: Screen_StatisticsBalance
evidence: Builds statistics balance screen from STATISTIKBILANZBACK.spr.

name: Screen_StatisticsBackdrop
evidence: Builds statistics backdrop from STATISTIKBACKSPRITE.spr.

name: Screen_StatisticsBranchBalance
evidence: Builds branch balance statistics screen from STATISTIKFILIALBILANZ.spr.

name: Screen_Personnel
evidence: Builds personnel screen from SK_PERSONAL.spr / PERSOPLAN.spr.

name: Screen_EndResults
evidence: Builds end-result/score screen from Pe_Endergebnis_Punkte.tga.
